title: Deliver an unfamiliar report
intro: This assessment combines ideas already taught. You will validate data, keep separate counts, handle an asynchronous failure, and write a test that detects a specific bug. Reading a finished solution can explain an approach, but it does not establish that you can solve the task independently. Use the acceptance criteria to decide when your work is complete.

outcomes.can: Validate a local asynchronous batch, classify invalid and duplicate rows, and write a regression that distinguishes correct and faulty duplicate handling.

steps.title: Predict the result
steps.text: Read each line before revealing the output.

steps.title: Trace the result
steps.text: A duplicate counter and a total counter measure different things. The example counts one repeated ID without adding a second unique ID. The final task adds validation and status counts. Its regression test must detect a faulty candidate as well as accept a correct one.

steps.title: Report audit
steps.text: Use the stated contract. Save to check the complete submission. Equivalent correct implementations are accepted.

choices.feedback: Two unique IDs and one repeated occurrence are counted separately.
That would count every occurrence as unique.

review.evidence: Attempt from a fresh workspace on a later visit. Record hints separately from independent success.
